title: When Myopic Managers Must Mark to Market
eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. Table 1 is a cross-sectional Cragg (1971) exponential hurdle model of CEO cash-out/insider sales on CEO pay duration; Tables 2-4 are event studies of bank stock returns (CARs and portfolio time-series regressions on an event-date dummy plus risk factors) around market-wide mark-to-market rule-change dates common to all banks, with cross-sectional splits by continuous CEO pay duration and capital ratio; Table 5 is a feedback-trading regression (Matlab, high-dimensional FE, two-way bootstrap) of securities sales on liquidity/fundamental factors interacted with continuous bank characteristics. No binary treatment switching on at unit-specific dates.
design_notes: Event dates are common calendar dates (Bowen and Khan 2014 rule-change events); treatment intensities are continuous (equity duration d_full, capital ratio changes).
data_files: Matlab codes for feedback trading regressions/m2m.xlsx
data_files_note: Analysis datasets shipped (ExecuComp/proxy, FR Y-9C, CRSP, Compustat derived).
screener_notes: Published text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2020.03249.txt; Management Science 70(9), 2024). No DiD design.
